title: World Trade Report 2026: global trade at a geoeconomic crossroads
discussion_signal: The post interprets the report as a critical juncture for the multilateral trading system, with geopolitics, industrial policy, technology competition, AI, environmental pressure, and supply-chain security reshaping trade. It adds a political-legitimacy dimension to institutional reform.
linked_research_question: How does geoeconomic fragmentation change the legitimacy, flexibility, and reform needs of multilateral trade institutions?
limits: Individual summary of a WTO report
